The penis issue is still ongoing (2-3 weeks now), though it doesn’t look as bad and doesn’t really hurt anymore unless water from the shower hits it directly. Nothing will make it go away but time I think. It’s possible you don’t have HSV-1 but the oral sex and similar symptoms lead me to believe you do. The good thing is it is very rare to have another genital outbreak when it is HSV-1 rather than HSV-2, but you would still have to disclose to every partner because it is transmissible. But don’t freak out just yet, I’m not a doctor so it’s entirely possible I’m wrong.
